mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate indicates a shift toward monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate indicates a shift toward monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 5% indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of UNRATE > 5.0 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below the prior month signals a contraction in domestic manufacturing capacity, which reduces future growth prospects and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of INDPRO < INDPRO_prev_month are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
